items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: He had me, had me get a band together with Santo... And, and, and Papa Sillis there

ctx.x: Roger Wolfe. He had me, had me get a band together with Santo, and I told you the, the, the name of the guys, you know. And, and, and Papa Sillis there, see. So, that was a, sort of a bucking contest there, as far as I was concerned, you know.
